column1: # The text series of GET /metrics of the store daemon (P/01.3 N1.3 metrics, N2). The norm refers to this table and does not repeat it in prose; the list is closed.
# A row is a series. labels — name=value|value… of each label, - without labels; type — gauge or counter (the word of # TYPE when it is given);
# emitted_by — which instances give the series: voter (a voter of a group: the leader and a follower), box (the store of a box), door (a door without a vote);
# a door without a vote is not a raft member: it gives no series configstore_raft_* and configstore_doors, otherwise dashboards would count it as a member of the group.
# value_rule — what the value is; «box: …» — the value at a box, one member.

column5: the sample of the current state has value 1; other state samples, when given, have value 0; box: state="leader" with value 1

the number of rows platform/configstore-doors/<id> that read in their own form with seen_at not older than DOOR_SEEN_PERIODS × DOOR_SEEN_EVERY; every voter, the leader and a follower, gives it by its own replica of the rows and its own clock, without asking the leader (with an unreachable leader the series is the same); box: 0

the requests that the door passed to the group, by outcome: answered — an answer of a voter was received, with any code; unavailable — no voter was reached, the door answered 503 unavailable; ambiguous — the write was sent, there is no answer, 503 ambiguous
the voters that answered the last membership poll of the door, once per DOOR_MEMBERS_EVERY
